item.bubie.bubie.new: Click the ground to switch your Bubie on.
item.bubie.bubie.off: Switched off: click the ground to turn it back on
item.bubie.bubie_clipboard.how1: Click 2 blocks: the corners of the area
item.bubie.bubie_clipboard.how2: Shift + click: a chest (drop-off) or Station (home)
item.bubie.bubie_clipboard.how3: Click the Bubie to hand it all over
item.bubie.chip.how: Click a Bubie with it, or put it in a chip slot
item.bubie.chip_magnet.desc: Pulls in items from up to 5 blocks away.
item.bubie.chip_smelting.desc: Raw ores come out smelted (uses more energy).
bubie.job.lumberjack.desc: Fells whole trees and replants the saplings. An axe makes it faster.
bubie.job.digger.desc: Digs sand, gravel, dirt and clay, layer by layer from the top. Give it a shovel.
bubie.job.quarry.desc: Digs out the whole area in layers and leaves a staircase on the walls. Plugs lava and water first. Needs a pickaxe.
bubie.job.farmer.desc: Harvests ripe crops and replants them. Also cane, cactus, bamboo, pumpkins, melons and sweet berries.
bubie.job.miner.desc: Goes for ores. Vein: the exposed ones in the area. Tunnel: branch tunnels at the bottom of the area. The pickaxe decides what it can mine.
bubie.job.collector.desc: Picks up every item on the ground in the area and stores it. Good next to automatic farms.
bubie.status.done: Done! The whole area is finished.
bubie.status.nothing_to_do: Nothing to do right now. It will look again soon.
bubie.status.no_area.help: Shift + click a chest (or a Station) with the Clipboard, then click the Bubie: it works around it. Or mark 2 corners for an area of your own.
bubie.status.area_too_big.help: Mark a smaller area, or install a Range Chip.
bubie.status.no_chest.help: Shift + click a chest with the Clipboard, then click the Bubie. A Station works too.
bubie.status.inventory_full.help: Empty the Bubie or give it a chest.
bubie.status.chest_full.help: Empty the chest or mark another one with the Clipboard.
bubie.status.no_tool.help: Put the right tool in the tool slot (a pickaxe for stone and ores).
bubie.status.tool_low.help: It stopped so your tool doesn't break. Repair or swap it.
bubie.status.no_energy.help: Put redstone in the fuel slot (or an FE battery), or bring it to a powered Station.
bubie.status.need_filler.help: There's water or lava nearby. Give it cobblestone or dirt to plug it before digging.
bubie.status.no_seeds.help: Put some seeds in its inventory.
bubie.message.not_yours: This Bubie belongs to someone else.
bubie.message.shut_down: %s shut down at %s %s %s. Pick up the item and switch it back on.
bubie.message.limit: You already have %s Bubies on. Fold one up (Shift + click with an empty hand) to place another.
bubie.clipboard.corner_a: First corner: %s %s %s. Click the second one.
bubie.clipboard.corner_b: Area marked: %s. Now click the Bubie.
bubie.clipboard.not_container: This doesn't hold items. Shift + click a chest or a Station.
bubie.clipboard.empty: The Clipboard is empty. Mark an area or a chest first.
bubie.clipboard.too_big: The area %s is too big (max %s). A Range Chip makes it bigger.
bubie.ui.area_help: Clipboard: Shift + click a chest and click the Bubie, and it works around it. Click 2 corners first for an area of your own.
bubie.ui.hint.tool: Tool: the Bubie uses it up. Axe, shovel or pickaxe, depending on the job.
bubie.ui.hint.fuel: Fuel: redstone dust or blocks… or a battery with FE (Voltaic pocket accumulator, Mekanism energy tablet, Powah battery), which charges the Bubie and is not used up. Coal does not work: it is a robot.
bubie.ui.hint.station_fuel: Redstone, if the station has no FE. Pipes and hoppers fill it too.
bubie.look.title: Edit my Bubie
bubie.job.builder.desc: Builds a Base Blueprint base block by block, taking the blocks from its chest. Set up the blueprint and click the Bubie with it where the base should go.
bubie.status.no_blueprint.help: Set up a Base Blueprint (Base Blueprint mod) and click the Bubie with it, where the base goes.
bubie.status.no_material.help: Its chest has none of the blueprint block. Put more in, or let another Bubie (Lumberjack, Quarry) fill it.
bubie.builder.no_material: Pick the blueprint material first (Shift + click a block with the blueprint).
bubie.job.courier.desc: Empties the chests, hoppers and furnace outputs in its area into its own chest. If that chest is a Builder's, it brings only what the blueprint still needs.
bubie.status.stuck.help: It couldn't walk anywhere for a while. Free it (a hole, a door, a fence) or bring it closer to the work.
bubie.ghost.place: %s goes here. Place it to help %s.
bubie.ui.dj.help: It plays the disc in this slot, over and over, for everyone nearby.
item.bubie.chip_program.desc: Unlocks the Miner, Builder, Courier and Guard jobs, on servers that require it.
bubie.job.guard.desc: Fights the monsters that come into its area (creepers are left alone) with the weapon in its tool slot, and picks up what they drop. It keeps watch at night.
bubie.status.needs_program.help: On this server the Miner, Builder, Courier and Guard need a Program Chip. Put one in a chip slot.
item.bubie.wireless_station.how1: Shift + click a Bubie Station to link it
item.bubie.wireless_station.how2: Right-click: where its Bubies are and what they are doing
bubie.wireless.unlinked: Not linked yet: Shift + click a Bubie Station with it
bubie.ui.station.none: No Bubie lives here yet. Shift + click this Station with the Clipboard, then click a Bubie.
bubie.ui.pit_in_front: It digs a pit in front of the chest, never under the base.
bubie.ui.tip.mode.follow: Walks after you and teleports when you get far away.
bubie.ui.tip.mode.stay: Stands still where it is and waits.
bubie.ui.tip.mode.work: Does its job around its chest (or in the area you marked).
bubie.ui.tip.job: Change the job. Miner, Builder, Courier and Guard may need a Program Chip on some servers.
bubie.ui.tip.radius: How far from its chest it works. Up to %s; Range Chips raise the limit. The new area shows in the world.
bubie.ui.tip.show: Outlines the work area, the chest and home in the world for ten seconds.
bubie.ui.tip.clear_area: Forgets the marked area: the Bubie goes back to working around its chest.
bubie.ui.tip.clear_chest: Forgets the chest: it keeps what it collects in its own storage.
bubie.ui.tip.clear_home: Forgets its home Station: it no longer goes there to charge or at night.
bubie.ui.tip.dj.play: Play the disc in the slot below.
bubie.status.nothing_to_do.digger: Nothing left to dig %s with these filters.
bubie.status.nothing_to_do.miner: No ores its pickaxe can mine %s.
bubie.status.nothing_to_do.builder: Nothing to build: click it with a set-up Blueprint.
bubie.status.tool_no_energy: Its tool is out of energy
bubie.status.tool_no_energy.help: The electric tool in its tool slot has an empty battery. Charge it, or give the Bubie an ordinary pickaxe, shovel or axe.
bubie.ui.hint.disc: A music disc for the DJ. It stays here: it never goes to the chest with the cargo.
